finding: Phosphate starvation caused >20-fold induction of D10 and D17 transcripts in rice roots, driving marked increase in root SL exudates.
Purified 5-deoxystrigol stimulated Gigaspora margarita hyphal branching at concentrations as low as 10^-13 M.
In the presence of GR24, D14 interacted with D3 and stimulated ubiquitination and rapid 26S proteasome degradation of D53.

source_location: Kapulnik et al. (2011) J Exp Bot 62:2915-2924
finding: GR24 stimulated root hair elongation in wild-type, but effect was substantially curtailed in ein2 ethylene-insensitive mutants.

Detailed pharmacological block with aminoethoxyvinylglycine (AVG) and 1-MCP showed GR24 retains significant residual root-hair elongation activity in ethylene-deficient/insensitive lines, proving an ethylene-independent pathway.
